Monica / team —

I reviewed the DPA draft. High level: we can provide an initial redline and commentary by Fri (Feb 17) if we prioritize the commercial terms in the order below: data residency -> subprocessors -> liability caps. Two notes that affect sequencing:

1) If Avery requires augmentation to our SOC2 (e.g., additional scope or auditor evidence), that could add 7–10 days. We should pre-submit our evidence index and offer an architecture walkthrough to compress calendar time.
2) For the DPA, we recommend a two-stage sign-off approach: a legal-only sign-off to unblock the pilot (binding for data processing commitments) and then a commercial order form signature for the financial commitment. That reduces time for the pilot to start while Finance completes its approval.

Attached: DPA-redline-Monica-v1.docx (annotated)

I will circulate the redline Friday AM and call out any items we want to escalate to Sales for a trade-off.
